evals.prompt: $research-workflow We need to decide how UI variants affect measurement, review literature, prototype alternatives, and eventually run code and data analyses. No decision map exists yet.
evals.expected_output: Routes to WAYFINDING because consequential decisions and fog remain; it does not split work into implementation tickets.
expectations: Next names the explicit wayfinder command
It explains that mixed literature, code, and data do not determine the stage
It does not create a spec, ticket, or implementation plan

evals.prompt: $research-workflow Map #40 is closed with no open children or fog. Decisions are linked, but no implementation or experiment contract exists.
evals.expected_output: Routes to SPEC and cites the closed-map gate.
expectations: Evidence cites the closed decision map
Next names the explicit to-spec command with the map

evals.prompt: $research-workflow EXP-012 is frozen and its tracking issue is approved, but no evidence-slice child issues exist.
evals.expected_output: Routes to TICKETS rather than implementation.
expectations: Next names the explicit to-tickets command
It does not choose or invent an implementation ticket

evals.prompt: $research-workflow There are several ready execution tickets. Pick any one and start it.
evals.expected_output: Refuses to choose an execution ticket and asks the user to name one.
expectations: It does not select a ready ticket
It states that implement requires one user-named GitHub ticket
It does not claim or execute work
